verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a REST API with API-key auth, a TypeScript SDK for building pieces, and an embedding SDK, plus an official MCP server enabling AI clients to drive the platform — solid first-party SDK/API surface for AI-native integration. However, there's no OpenAPI spec found (probe returned 404s across candidate paths), no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK usability, and community feedback flags friction in local dev setup. Missing for 10: published OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent developer corroboration of SDK reliability, clearer versioned SDK release/changelog evidence.
